hero.headline: What's new in Certxa.
hero.subhead: We ship updates every week. Here's everything we've released, in reverse order.

items.text: Autumn AI now supports multi-language responses — English, Spanish, and Vietnamese.
Turn rotation queue now shows estimated wait time to clients on the kiosk screen.
Loyalty punch cards can now be configured with custom expiry windows (30, 60, 90, or 180 days).
New Hardware page in the dashboard for managing connected devices and checking firmware versions.
Fixed an edge case where back-to-back appointments could overlap by 1 minute on certain timezone configurations.
Receipt printer now correctly handles special characters in service names.
Introduced Points per Dollar loyalty mode alongside the existing punch card system.
Clients can now view their loyalty balance and history from the booking confirmation page.
Dashboard analytics now include a 90-day revenue trend chart.
Booking confirmation emails redesigned — cleaner layout, salon logo, and one-tap reschedule link.
Staff payroll report now exportable as CSV and PDF.
Resolved a display issue on the kiosk where service prices weren't showing for walk-in clients.
Launched Certxa Kiosk hardware — self check-in tablet with integrated turn queue management.
Review Management: automated post-visit Google review requests with customizable timing.
POS checkout flow reduced from 5 taps to 3 for the most common transaction types.
